Hi, I'm the growth analytics lead at a DTC pet food subscription brand. Our CFO is deciding whether to double our paid social budget for FY2024, and she needs a rigorous, presentation-ready analysis before the board meeting next week.

We've been using a rough CAC number of around CNY 300 internally (just ad spend divided by customers), but our finance team flagged that this doesn't capture everything we actually spend to acquire customers. We need the real, fully-loaded number.

For the LTV side, we want to understand what these paid social customers are actually worth to us over a 12-month horizon — and it needs to be on gross profit, not just top-line revenue. Our CFO specifically does not trust revenue-based LTV numbers.

All the relevant raw data is in the workspace:
- `data/raw_orders/paid_social_orders_2023.csv` — order history for FY2023 paid social customers
- `data/marketing/paid_social_cost_breakdown_2023.txt` — full marketing cost details

Please produce a complete analysis report saved as `ltv_cac_report.md`. The CFO also wants a reusable script embedded in the report so we can re-run this quarterly without starting from scratch. Make sure you clearly flag what the riskiest assumption in the model is — she'll push back hard on anything that looks like wishful thinking.
